THE r6 HEADLINE IS FIXED AND I SAY SO PLAINLY. The apple in shots/r7-iphone/11-combo+550ms, gained and cropped 7x, has a real stalk standing proud of the limb, a stem well under it and a shoulder crest around it. I can name it from that crop unlabelled. In r6 it was a smooth green ball. The builder also proved a genuine negative theorem on the way (an axisymmetric concavity can never notch an outline, because at screen-x 0 the far meridian always contributes +r sin t) — that is why the r6 cv FELL while the well was being worked on, and it is correct.

THE NEW GAP, VERIFIED IN SOURCE, NOT INFERRED. `grep -n 'uv(' src/fruit/species.js` returns exactly ONE line, 1110, inside capCoords (the CUT-FACE material), and it reads `uv().y.clamp(0.0, 1.0)`. There is no `leaf`, no `wood`, no `crown`, no `sepal`, no `blade` token anywhere in species.js. geometry.js:1741 emits ONE group for all skin and species.js binds ONE MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial per fruit, driven off positionGeometry. So the mask geometry.js writes at line 1618/1631 (1.75 + 0.20v for woody, 1.0 + 0.70h/crownMax for foliage) has no consumer and cannot have one. This is a contract the geometry file has documented as live since round 4 and that has never existed.

WHAT IT COSTS, ON THE DELIVERED FRAMES. shots/r7-iphone/11-combo+550ms cropped 6x: the pineapple crown is 24 broad gold straps the same hue as the fruit body — a wheat sheaf or a feather duster. plate-01's pineapple crown is grey-green and that colour break is half of what names a pineapple at a glance. shots/r7/11-combo+550ms cropped 8x: the strawberry's five sepals are RED, the same red as the body, so the star the builder just spent the round authoring is invisible as a calyx. shots/r7-iphone/11 apple: the stalk is light green, not woody brown. The geometry is present and paid for in triangles; the paint erases it. This is the reason 'name the fruit from its outline' now passes for the apple and still fails for the pineapple and strawberry in the full frame.
